description: A reed horn's blast: 'a steel reed vibrated by compressed air' (IHO S-12) giving 'a high-pitched note' (Bowditch), thinner than a diaphone's, at pitch with a slight waver of vibrato cents at rate times a second. No source gives its pitch (an electric horn 'resonates at about 670 Hz', a maker's sheet): a starting value. harmonics are the partials' levels. A point source: its level falls 6 dB each time the distance doubles from near metres. Frequencies in Hz, times in seconds, levels as gains.
